model_source: 项目导航\GeoExplorer资源验证_v1\公开来源\GeoExplorer__models__model_falcon.py
observations: each recorded observation index once in its own microbatch; repeated exposure across microbatches retained
labels: four Bernoulli labels per position, one or two positive except all zero at goal
positional_alignment: goal feature token0; observed states at 1+2*i; directional predictions hidden_states[:,1::2]
weighting: BCE default mean over 1*N*4; pretrain loss divided by256; per-position weight1/N, per-component1/(4*N*256)
history: prefix classification: goal in future does not count as observed; no future action or image used
causal_scope: Bound alibi=false/SDPA causal branches statically checked; no runtime/model-forward proof in this task
